title: Smiling Woman Petting Donkeys at Farm, 1950s Deckle Edge Vintage Photo
description: A charming mid-century black and white snapshot capturing an older woman wearing a buttoned dress, spectacles, and a patterned headscarf as she gently reaches out to pet a pair of donkeys over a rustic wooden fence. Set beneath an open timber-framed barn or shelter, the scene reflects leisurely mid-century day trips and farm visits, printed on classic deckle-edged photo paper.
